brief:
Gaza's Ministry of Health warned that the psychological condition of young people in the territory has become "alarming" after three years of Israeli warfare, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry said 98% of youth live in constant anxiety about their lives, while 39% experience other psychological symptoms.

The health authority also documented that 2,027 patients died before evacuation could be arranged.

title: Gaza health ministry reports depression afflicts 57% of youth
